description: Interaction state rules for architect step. Ensures interfaces.md and workplan cover UX states.

rules.rule: Every entity in the spec MUST have DELETE endpoint in interfaces.md, not just GET/POST/PUT.
rules.workplan_check: be_tasks includes a task for delete handler with confirmation response.

rules.rule: Every API endpoint MUST document error response shapes (400 validation, 404 not found, 500 server error).
workplan.json fe_tasks MUST cover ALL modules from the spec, not just the first module. Structure: skeleton tasks first (navigation, shared components), then per-module tasks.
fe_tasks MUST include tasks for: loading states, empty states, error handling, and operation feedback (toast/notifications).
rules.workplan_check: fe_tasks references loading, empty, error, toast/notification.

rules.rule: Derive validation rules from the spec (not hardcoded): (a) required fields = spec fields marked required/not-null; (b) enum whitelists = any spec field with documented allowed values; (c) foreign keys = any spec relationship (e.g. comment→ticket); (d) max length = any spec field with size constraint, else 500 default. interfaces.md MUST document the 400 validation response shape {error: string, field: string, message: string} and apply it to every POST/PUT.
rules.workplan_check: be_tasks includes 'validate input' subtask per POST/PUT endpoint referencing the spec's required/enum/FK constraints.

rules.rule: DELETE /resource/:id MUST check existence first. Return 404 if id not found, 204 on successful delete. Never return 200 success for missing rows.
rules.workplan_check: be_tasks for DELETE include 'check exists or 404' step.
